messages:
maria: Quick Q — customer demo at 16:00 PT, I need a short list of dashboards/panels to show TTFT (p50/p95/p99) + tokens/sec by model and route, and a trace to demo the slow path. Where should I point them?
kevin: Short answer: Grafana dashboard 'Inference - TTFT & Tokenflow' is the one. Bookmark: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/9c1a/inference-ttft-tokenflow. Key panels: 'TTFT p50/p95/p99 (by model)', 'Tokens/sec (route)', and the p99 heatmap. For traces use Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/explore?service=inference-runtime
sam: Also pull logs from Loki, quick query to find slow requests: `{app="inference"} |= "ttft_ms" | json | ttft_ms > 1000`
julia: If you want to show cold vs warm path, slice the panels by `is_cache_hit`. The Grafana dash exposes `$cache_hit` var (true/false) so you can flip during demo.
maria: Nice — any panel IDs I can deep link to specific visuals?
kevin: Yep: panel ids on that dash: p12 (TTFT by model), p17 (tokens/sec by route), p21 (TTFT p99 heatmap). Deep link example: `https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/9c1a/inference-ttft-tokenflow?viewPanel=p12&orgId=1`
sam: PromQL for tokens/sec (quick): `sum(rate(tokens_processed_total{env="prod"}[1m])) by (model,route)`
sam: And a handy TTFT p95 query: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(ttft_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le, model))`
julia: For traces, search Jaeger for operation `ServeRequest` and filter `model_family` tag. For quicktrace example use operation `DecodeRequest` with duration>500ms.
maria: What about alerts? I don't want p95 to trigger during the demo if we know deploy noise exists.
sam: Current p95 alert is `ttft_p95 > 800`ms for 5m. Options: 1) create a silence for the demo window, 2) temporary adjust threshold, or 3) add a runbook note when acknowledging.
julia: @eng-oncall-bot can you create a temporary silence for the demo window?
eng-oncall-bot: I can do that but need the UTC window. Also recommend bookmarking the panels so you can deep-link straight into the visual.
maria: UTC window: 2026-03-17T23:55:00Z - 2026-03-18T00:20:00Z. Also want a short trace that shows KV cache miss flow to explain cold path.
kevin: I'll create the silence and add a bookmark. For a demo trace, query Jaeger: `operation=DecodeRequest` and filter `duration>500ms`. Example trace id we can pull up: `f2a1b8c3` if you want a ready sample.
sam: Quick note — if p99 gets noisy, point to fallback policy in logs: stream `deployment.fallbacks` contains `from_variant -> fallback_variant` entries.
julia: I'll drop a 1-slide cheat sheet in the demo notes with exact panel deep links + the PromQL + Loki queries.
maria: Perfect. Can one of you ping me here when the silence + bookmark are live?
kevin: Will do, pinging once done.
eng-oncall-bot: Silence created by kevin — ID S-20260317-01, ends 2026-03-18T00:20:00Z
kevin: Bookmark added: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/9c1a/inference-ttft-tokenflow?viewPanel=p12&orgId=1&edit=false
maria: Awesome, starting prep now :raised_hands:
